Name: BARRIER
Main Effect:
You create a barrier made of light on **an entity** you can touch.

The target gains [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in Shield.

Name: BOLSTER
Main Effect:
You form a halo on **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)** that lasts for **1 hour**.

The halo grants advantage to all actions for its duration.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Bolster, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity** with Bolster.

Name: LIGHT
Main Effect: You conjure an orb of golden light at a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**, illuminating a **15-meter (50-foot)** radius.
Secondary Effect:
While Light is active, you may spend 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower.

If you do, the orb explodes. Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all entities** within **6 meters (20 feet)**. On a success, they are blinded **until their next Turn End**.

Name: LIGHTFORGED WEAPON
Main Effect:
You conjure an ethereal weapon of pure light in a shape of your choice at a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** that lasts for **3 turns**. It cannot be damaged or destroyed.

When summoned and at your Turn Start, it teleports to a point within **15 meters (50 feet)** and you make a {stat} Melee Attack {roll} against **an adjacent entity**. On a hit, it deals [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
While Lightforged Weapon is active, you may spend 4 Action Points.

If you do, the Lightforged Weapon makes an additional {stat} Melee Attack {roll} against **an eligible target**.

Name: ORBITING ARSENAL
Main Effect: You conjure 6 Lightmade Weapons taking the form you wish, and they float around you for up to **1 hour**.
Secondary Effect:
While you still have Lightmade Weapons active, you may spend 2 Action Points.

If you do, you launch a Lightmade Weapon at **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**. Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.

Name: WINGS OF RADIANCE
Main Effect:
You manifest golden, feathered wings on **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** that last for **3 hours**.

While the wings last, the entity can fly at a speed equal to its Movement Speed.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Wings of Radiance, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity** with Wings of Radiance.

Name: SIGIL OF TRUTH
Main Effect:
You manifest a Sigil of Truth, targeting any number of entities you can see.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **every entity** targeted. On a success, they are bound to the sigil.

If a bound entity utters a lie, the sigil shatters and brands them with its mark for **1 hour**.
Secondary Effect:
While a branding lasts, you may spend 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, consume one branding to compel that entity to truthfully answer a single yes-or-no question.

Name: HARD LIGHT
Main Effect:
You conjure a static construct of solid light in a shape you wish, such as a wall or a bridge, at a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

The construct cannot exceed a volume of **125 cubic meters (5x5x5 meters)**.

The construct has Health equal to [[10*stat]] and Defense equal to [[2*stat]]. It lasts until it is destroyed, you take a long rest or you fall unconscious.

Name: CELESTIAL EDICT
Main Effect:
You issue a divine edict to **an entity** that can hear you within **9 meters (30 feet)**, forbidding it from taking a specific type of action for **3 turns**.

When proclaiming the edict, choose one: movement, weapon actions, casting a spell or using an ability.

Whenever the entity attempts an action matching the proclaimed edict, make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex.

On a success, a bolt of sacred lightning strikes them, dealing [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.

Name: LIGHTSTRIDER GATEWAY
Main Effect:
You manifest a portal of pure light in a space adjacent to you and designate a point you can see within **5 kilometers (3 miles)** that lasts for **15 minutes**.

Entities that walk through the portal are transformed into pure light, traveling at light speed to reappear at the chosen point.

Name: GUARDIAN ANGEL
Main Effect:
You manifest a Guardian Angel at a point you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)** that lasts for **10 turns**, taking the form of a medium-sized entity of your choice.

The Guardian Angel cannot be damaged directly and has Health equal to [[20*stat]].

Whenever **an ally** within line of sight of the Guardian Angel takes damage, that damage is negated and the Guardian Angel loses Health equal to the damage prevented.

While the Guardian Angel persists, allies within line of sight gain the benefits of {{Bolster}}.

Name: BEND LIGHT
Main Effect:
You bend light around **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)** for **1 hour**.

While the spell lasts, the entity is almost completely invisible. It gains 2 advantage when trying to hide or when taking a stealth-related action.

Whenever the entity takes an action that is not a movement one, it must make an {instinct} Roll against the Grit of that action’s target. On a failure, the spell ends and they become visible.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Bend Light, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity** with Bend Light.

Name: THEON PERFECT REPLICANTS
Main Effect:
The next Action you perform that targets **a single entity** is blessed by celestial might.

That Action targets **every entity** you can see instead. You may have it target only hostile entities or only allied ones.

Name: SCOURGE
Main Effect:
You form a Crown of Shadows on **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**, weakening its soul for **1 hour**.

The Crown of Shadows imposes disadvantage on all actions the entity attempts.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Scourge, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity** with Scourge.

Name: CLOUD MIND
Main Effect:
You cloud the mind of **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** for **1 hour**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, it does not perceive the presence of you and your allies as odd or unusual, allowing you passage in places you would otherwise not be allowed.

When the spell ends, or if the roll fails, the target becomes aware that you altered its mind.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Cloud Mind, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity** with Cloud Mind.

Name: GLOOM SPIKE
Main Effect:
You assault the mind of **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** with a spike of shadow.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.

It also ends any effect the entity was paying Upkeep for.

Name: DARK BARGAIN
Main Effect:
You offer **an entity** you can see a dark bargain.

If it accepts, it sacrifices Health equal to 3 times its level and gains advantage on its next action.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Dark Bargain, you may spend an additional 2 Willpower.

If you do and the target accepts, it sacrifices an additional Health equal to 3 times its level and also gains Empowered and Elevated on its next action.

Name: SHADOW HEX
Main Effect:
You afflict **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** with a creeping, waking nightmare that lasts for **10 minutes**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the target is hexed.

Whenever a hexed target fails a roll, it takes [[1d6 + stat]] in {damage} damage.

Name: EFFIGY
Main Effect:
You create a small doll linked to **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**, or to **an entity** from whom you possess a physical sample such as hair, blood or skin.

The effigy perfectly mirrors the physical condition and Health of the target, letting you track its current well-being and active statuses.

The effigy lasts until it is destroyed or the target dies.
Secondary Effect:
While the effigy lasts, you may spend 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower.

If you do, you scry through the effigy for a brief, soundless 10-second vision of the target’s location.

Name: COGNITIVE DISTORTION
Main Effect:
You trick the mind of **an entity** that can hear you within **9 meters (30 feet)**, altering its perception of reality for **1 hour**.

You make a statement to the target of no more than six words. It cannot be directly harmful to the target, and it cannot lead to the target killing itself.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the target believes the statement to be true and only realizes it has been tricked when the spell ends.

The spell ends if the target takes any damage.

Name: SHADOW BIND
Main Effect:
Chains of shadow attempt to bind **an entity** you can touch for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex. On a success, it is constrained.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 2 Willpower to keep the chains bound. If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.

Each time you pay it, make another {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Reflex. On a failure, the spell ends.

Name: JULES’ ABSOLUTE EDICT
Main Effect:
You issue an edict, commanding **an entity** that can hear you within **9 meters (30 feet)** to take a specific action of your choice, against a target of your choice.

At its Turn Start, it must fulfill your command. If the target refuses to obey before its **next Turn End**, it takes [[8d6 + 8*stat]] in {damage} damage.

The edict must command an action that is feasible for the entity, so you cannot order a non-flying creature to fly. The spell fails if the command is impossible. The command may involve actions that put the creature at risk.

Name: HAUNTING SHADOWS
Main Effect:
You send shadow to haunt **an entity** you can see within **12 meters (40 feet)** for **24 hours**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, paranoia grips the target for as long as the spell lasts: it cannot rest, it cannot regain Health and it has disadvantage on skill checks.
Secondary Effect:
While Haunting Shadows is active, you may spend 4 Action Points and 12 Willpower.

If you do, you and **up to 5 entities** you can touch are teleported to the haunted target and emerge from its shadow, ending Haunting Shadows.

Name: UMBRAL FORM
Main Effect:
You turn yourself into an umbral form, made of shadow **until your next Turn Start**.

While made of shadow you have resistance to all damage.

You can also slip through any crack or gap that air can travel through, letting you pass between bars and under doors, as long as the passage does not exceed 6 seconds.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you may pay 3 Willpower to hold the umbral form **until your next Turn Start**.

If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.

Name: GLOOM ECHO
Main Effect:
Your shadow emerges from the ground, and the next Action you take is also performed by your shadow.

The echo is an exact duplicate of that Action, using the same dice results and values.
